content: Otpusknye formula per ст.139 ТК РФ: average daily earnings = (sum of earnings in the 12 calendar months preceding vacation month) / 12 / 29.3. If period not fully worked, actually-worked months/days used instead. Excluded from both the earnings sum and the day count: sick leave, other paid leave, business trips, maternity/parental leave, unpaid leave, employer-caused downtime. Excluded from earnings only: social assistance, non-performance bonuses (birthday etc), meal/transport reimbursements. Included: base salary, performance bonuses earned within the period, shift/night premiums.
